FACT: Ned decided to quietly stop showing up to group social events. Not an announcement — just fading out. Rationale: group is neither interesting to him nor interested in him. Menial jobs, no ambition, 'plain existing.'
CLOSE FRIEND SITUATION: Fight escalated from Ned saying he might not join an evening because he was in a bad mood. Instead of asking what was wrong, she said 'you always do this.' Ned's take: 'I'm so fucking tired of feeling not enough for someone.' Not a full break but stepping back.
CONTEXT: Ned acknowledged some of this might be dopamine flatness making everyone seem boring. Intends to hold final judgment until after meds. But the quiet withdrawal is happening regardless.
AFFECTS: Going through a period of solitude. Freelance client + BasedSpace office provides some social structure. Intends to find people with matching intensity (founders, climbers, AI people) rather than force existing connections.
NOTE: Don't push him to reconcile. This is a settled decision.
